hard_constraints: Single POV: Ben Skywalker throughout; no head-hopping or external perspectives.

Preserve Torin's warmth register as load-bearing: use preserved specimens like 'You know what I love about modern Jedi? You still believe the dark side is a place you can choose not to go.' and maintain storytelling inflection with wry historical framing.
Jacen named once only per R13: 'Like Jacen.' Not repeated; Ben thinks of him as 'Jacen' with emotional charge, not 'Caedus'.
Use Star Wars terminology: caf (not coffee), datapad (not laptop), common area aboard YT-series freighter.
Force described experientially per force_mechanics: no clinical framing; Ben's read of Torin as 'warm and heavy' post-breach.
Style: Capitalize 'Human'; lowercase 'galaxy'; 'Jedi' singular/plural; American English.
canon_risks: Torin's NSW-era battle stories must evoke New Jedi Order battle memoir register without anachronisms; ground in Legends precedents like Ruusan Reformations or Brotherhood of Darkness without contradicting canon_preserved.
Ben's GAG service under Jacen: shared shame with Desh must align with Legacy of the Force/Fate of the Jedi details – teenage service, secret police complicity.
legends_continuity_notes: Jacen Solo: Fell to dark side as Darth Caedus, murdered Mara Jade Skywalker; Ben's cousin and former mentor in GAG. Reference carries personal weight for Ben.
Ben Skywalker: 20-21 in 47 ABY, post-Abeloth; experienced but exhausted by crises (Vong War aftermath, GAG, Caedus, Vestara, Abeloth).
Torin Hal: NSW Battle Master (~1000 BBY); stories should reference canon events like Battle of Veranthos (AU) or Ruusan without Legacy comics future bleed.
Galactic Alliance Guard (GAG): Jacen Solo's secret police during Second Galactic Civil War; Ben/Desh served as teens, source of unprocessed shame.
Steady Returns: Modified YT-series freighter; cramped common area fits group dynamics.
required_context_for_drafter: Setting: Steady Returns common area, late second shift; ambient ship hum, caf pot on table.

Characters: All present – Torin laughing/storytelling (warm, paternal), Desh (dry humor, steady eyes), Sera (formal, accepts caf with Dantari inclination), Kael (watchful, minimal dialogue), Ben (internal analysis).
Key beats: Torin laughs at Desh's joke (perfect timing); battle story pattern (decided/acted/bore cost); pours Sera's caf unhurriedly mid-story; Ben/Desh eye contact, 'Like Jacen' whispered once.
Emotional arc: Watchful -> recognition -> irresolution (caf gesture complicates pattern).
Torin counter-current 4: Caf pour as small kindness refusing simple pattern fit.

Warmth load-bearing: Torin's laugh/stories humanize before pattern name.

Sera Varik, Kael Drenn as survivors/anchors; group dynamics post-fortress awakening.
